name: remote-auto-reload
description: Automatically reloads a Remote-SSH window when its connection is permanently lost and the host is reachable again.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only machine-scoped settings are used; a workspace cannot influence what this extension runs.

remoteAutoReload.enabled.description: Watch Remote-SSH windows and reload them when the connection is permanently lost.

remoteAutoReload.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check the remote connection, in milliseconds.

remoteAutoReload.graceTicks.markdownDescription: How many consecutive failed checks before a reload is considered. VS Code retries on its own for up to 3 hours, so a short outage usually heals without a reload, and this grace period is what stops a self-healing window from being reloaded out from under you. Counted in checks rather than elapsed time so that a laptop which merely slept through the grace period does not skip it.

remoteAutoReload.healthTimeoutMs.description: How long a remote health check may take before it counts as unhealthy, in milliseconds.

remoteAutoReload.hostProbeTimeoutMs.description: How long the host reachability probe may take before it counts as unreachable, in milliseconds.

remoteAutoReload.reloadWhenDirty.markdownDescription: Reload even when there are unsaved editors. Off by default: with unsaved changes the extension shows a notification and lets you decide, so a reload can never discard your work.

remoteAutoReload.promptBeforeReload.description: Always ask before reloading, even when nothing is unsaved.

remoteAutoReload.hostProbeCommand.markdownDescription: Overrides how host reachability is probed. `${host}` becomes the ssh destination of the current window (including the user, e.g. `jun@box`) and `${port}` its port; both are shell-quoted. Leave empty to use `ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${host} true`, which proves sshd is answering and accepts your key. It does not prove the VS Code server will start, so a host that is up with a wedged server is still reloaded into. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot set this.
